items.title: Lawyer caught offering to make illegal-worker fine go away
items.summary: Because of our investigation, the home secretary has ordered a review of how fines are issued and collected.

items.title: Man arrested in Pakistan over $126m counterfeit postage scheme
items.summary: A man has been arrested in Pakistan and accused of running a counterfeit postage operation costing the US Postal Service $126m (£94m).

items.title: Giant tunnel proposed to clean up Windermere's sewage problem
items.summary: The plan would eliminate sewage spills into Windermere, blamed for turning the water green.

items.title: Uganda reacts angrily as Nigeria confirms its first Ebola case
items.summary: Nigeria has recorded its first case of Ebola during the current outbreak, the country's health ministry has said - as the virus continues to spread internationally.

items.title: Man charged after three Jewish women assaulted
items.summary: The women suffered minor injuries when they were assaulted at Clapton Common, police say.

items.title: Exceeding key climate target is now 'imminent and unavoidable'
items.summary: Exceeding a key global climate target is now "imminent and unavoidable", United Nations (UN) scientists have warned.
